applies_why: The judge is assessing a link dispute over Isaiah 7:14 where the challenger's own chain of wording evidence is pressed against the defender's link, so K-C's chain-collision requirement governs.
quote: D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: 'chain against chain by footing'—read as requiring comparison of the support of the full chains, versus read as satisfied by noting that each side answered a different aspect (wording versus prophetic application).
why: The judge declares the link underdetermined because the two sides answered different aspects rather than weighing the chains by footing, leaving undone what K-C requires.
